title: Customer claim deadline and documents (website wording)
keywords: claim deadline days lost damaged written notice documents waybill invoice receipt
body: Customers must submit claims in writing to express@uparcel.sg with the original waybill, invoices/receipts and any proof requested. One claim per item.
T&C: written notice within 3 working days of delivery (or of discovering hidden damage), and no later than 5 calendar days after delivery. Supporting documents within 7 days of being asked.
Internal rule (SOP §8.1): claims later than 5 calendar days are rejected. Tell customers to claim as early as possible and within 3 working days.
escalate: T&C has several conflicting deadlines (48 hrs, 2 days, 3 days). Carmen to confirm the one agents should quote.
